== Published English Original Virtual Set 1 wording ==
The 2006 text makes the Imperial warrior yours, removes the separate sentence authorizing firing during a battle or attack, and attaches same or adjacent site directly to the targeting instruction. It also drops immediately from the target-loss result. Chief Bast, the target kinds, cost, destiny modifier and defense comparison remain.
